all: Chinese Government donates 10,000 tents worth RMB 20 million for earthquake aid (Linked to Project ID#71479)
Chinese Government grants additional medical supplies worth 18 million RMB (linked to #40193)
Chinese Government provides a $2.6 million USD grant to Haiti in additional emergency earthquake response aid
China donates first batch of aid materials worth 13 million RMB to Haiti for disaster relief (linked to #40209 and #40202)
China sends Haiti second shipment of relief materials worth 12 million RMB (linked to #40190 and #40202)
Government of China commits emergency relief grants of 10 million RMB to Government of Haiti
Chinese Government provides 1 million USD to the Red Cross Society of China for the provision of earthquake relief aid to Haiti
China sends third batch of supplies, worth 5 million RMB, to Haiti for earthquake aid (linked to #40190 and #40209)
China grants $500,000 for provision of Humanitarian Air Services
Government of China donates 500,000 USD to Haiti through the United Nations Development Programme
